compute_ranking_softmax_loss: compute ranking softmax loss from logits and labels using optax losses
compute_ranking_softmax_loss_with_mask: compute ranking softmax loss with a where mask to ignore invalid items
compute_ranking_softmax_loss_with_weight: compute ranking softmax loss with per-item weights applied to labels
compute_ranking_softmax_loss_with_sum_re: compute ranking softmax loss using jnp.sum reduction instead of mean
compute_ranking_softmax_loss_gradients: compute gradients of ranking softmax loss using jax.grad transformation
